assets.prompt:
Generate one single transparent 2-row by 3-column source sprite atlas for an original children's learning game about a cozy park supply station in late autumn. Landscape 1536×1024 proportion. True transparent alpha between all six art pieces, no checkerboard, no dividing lines. Each cell has an intact single asset centered within its own cell with a fully clear transparent safety margin at least 10% on all sides. Nothing touches the bounds of its own cell. No text, lettering, numbers, emblems, labels, or watermarks.

Consistent fine paper grain, matte gouache, and clean cut-paper silhouettes in pine green and warm cream with apricot and persimmon accents. Simple, readable assets with bold contours and calm colors.

Row 1, cell 1: A complete wide 16:9 rectangular park supply-station backdrop, with a subtle small wooden shelter and pine trees at the edges and a broad quiet muted green central clearing. Fill this self-contained picture rectangle to its edges, with crisp straight rectangle boundaries and no surrounding border; keep everything outside the rectangular picture transparent. No feed packets, counting objects, signage, or people in this backdrop.
Row 1, cell 2: One single upright blank kraft paper seed bag with a flat crimped apricot seal, simple little tapered silhouette, flat warm beige face, no printing and nothing next to it. It should look exactly like one small packet when rendered repeatedly at tiny sizes.
Row 1, cell 3: One single closed, long rectangular warm green wooden supply box with a simple cream latch, slight three-quarter view, broad silhouette, no contents visible.
Row 2, cell 1: One friendly small green toy snake head facing right, with a pale cream cheek and small dark round eye, no body attached, broad round contour, mouth closed. This will be the steering avatar in a park-route game.
Row 2, cell 2: One small persimmon and gold bird-feather achievement sticker with thick cream silhouette border, diagonal like a feather found by a child, no symbols.
Row 2, cell 3: One small cozy brown park sparrow in side profile, facing left with wings tucked, cinnamon cheek and cream breast, whole bird and both feet visible, no branch or other item.
